name: Wind speed at 2 m
sampling: NASA POWER values at the centre of each 5-degree cell (point samples, not area averages)
source: NASA POWER monthly point API (MERRA-2), sampled every 5 degrees; usual = Mann-Kendall p < 0.05; pre-whitened = Mann-Kendall after lag-1 pre-whitening, p < 0.05; honest = pre-whitened with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 10% across all points of this variable
